pages.title: Structure
pages.body:
# STRUCTURE OF THE UNION

- **Central Committee** — supreme organ, chaired by the General Secretary
- **Council of Ministers** — government, headed by the Premier
- **Republics** — fifteen SSRs, each with its First Secretary
- **Red Army** — defence of the Union
- **MVD** — internal order
- **KGB** — state security

*Edit this page from the committee menu.*
